data.explanation: This is a normal invoice for an order of two toner cartridges and copy paper. The total is €156.91. The letter contradicts itself: the text asks for payment by 13 May 2026, but a separate line shows a due date of 20 May 2026. To be safe, pay by the earlier date, 13 May 2026, or ask the company which date applies. Use the invoice number BB-4471 as the payment reference. If this was a business purchase, keep the invoice for your records, as it may matter for your tax return.
data.tax_note: Office supplies may be deductible if used for work or business; keep the invoice (net €131.86, VAT €25.05).
